Fetch enrollment share by student group from the School Performance Reports

Source: R/fetch_spr_enrollment_by_group.R
fetch_spr_enrollment_by_group.Rd

The percent of each school's (or district's) enrollment in each student group, from the "Enrollment Trends by Student Group" sheet of the NJ School Performance Reports, in one layout for every year 2016-17 through 2024-25.

Usage

fetch_spr_enrollment_by_group(end_year, level = "school")

Arguments

end_year

A school year end, 2017-2025 (2016-17 is 2017).

level

"school" (default) or "district". The district file also holds the state rows.

Value

A data frame, columns in this order:

end_year

integer

county_id, county_name, district_id, district_name, school_id, school_name

character; school_id is "999" on district and state rows

subgroup

character, the student group

pct

numeric, the published percent of enrollment (0-100). NA when NJDOE published a range, a bound or a suppression note instead of one number, or left the cell blank.

pct_published

character, the cell exactly as NJDOE published it (for example "39.1", "39.1%", "<=5%", "20-30%")

is_state, is_county, is_district, is_school, is_charter, is_charter_sector, is_allpublic

logical entity flags

Details

NJDOE changed this sheet's layout several times (one row per group in 2016-17, one column per group afterward, text cells with percent signs in 2024-25, five school years per sheet in 2024-25). This function returns one row per entity x student group for the requested year only; earlier years in a trend sheet are dropped, and come from their own year's file.

Subgroup names are stable across NJDOE's relabels: English Learners and Multilingual Learners are both "limited english proficiency"; Homeless Students and Students Experiencing Homelessness are both "homeless students". "non-binary/undesignated gender" has rows only in years NJDOE published it (district file from 2019-20, school file from 2020-21).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
groups <- fetch_spr_enrollment_by_group(2024)
econ <- groups[groups$subgroup == "economically disadvantaged", ]
} # }
